messages:
maria: Quick experimental summary — I ran a focused sweep on microbatch sizes for streaming chat vs non-streaming completions. Goal: find mb defaults that respect p95/p99 latency SLOs without throwing away throughput.
alex: Numbers from a 3-run average on model-redwood-v1-13B (fp16 quant) on r-gpu-8: 
- streaming mb=1: avg 22ms/token, p95 60ms, p99 240ms, qps ~85
- streaming mb=4: avg 18ms/token, p95 72ms, p99 560ms, qps ~220
- completions (sync) mb=4: avg 25ms/token, p95 90ms, p99 150ms, qps ~320
Observations: streaming sees big p99 amplification as mb increases.

jin: Profile traces show most p99s come from KV-cache miss + attention kernel fallback sequence. Example trace snippet:
```
[0.000] RPC recv
[0.004] kv-lookup -> MISS
[0.006] merge-batch -> kernel-select(fallback)
[0.010] launch generic-attn kernel (tiled)
[0.180] kernel finish
```
When two streaming requests coalesce we sometimes concatenate prefixes which bumps effective seq_len and triggers tiled kernels.
maria: So it's an interaction: batching heuristic + kernel-selection heuristic + KV warmup. The handshake/prefix in streaming amplifies seq_len when mb>1.
alex: Our current kernel heuristic: if effective_seq_len > 512 -> tile-attn else fused-attn. That threshold was tuned for throughput, but it doesn't consider streaming handshake inflating seq_len temporarily.
sam: FWIW, we saw a prod regression yesterday when a canary set streaming mb=4; p99 jumped and alerted SLOs. Rolling that canary back to mb=1 cleared incidents.
maria: Proposal/actionable: 1) Per-route defaults (streaming -> mb=1, non-streaming -> mb=4); 2) Add a "streaming" kernel-hint that biases toward fused-attn up to higher seq_len to avoid tiled fallbacks; 3) Early KV prefetch during handshake to reduce misses.
jin: Put a quick patch in runtime: if request.flags.streaming && avg_batch_seq_len < 800 then prefer fused-attn. Local test: streaming mb=2 p99 reduced from 560ms -> 180ms, qps up slightly.
alex: Can we gate any mb>1 for streaming behind two runtime conditions: kernel-hint enabled AND kv-prefetch enabled? Also add a 'kv_miss_tail' metric to detect regressions early.
deploy-bot: rollout/mb-tuning started for stage cluster at 4356789015 by maria :rocket:
maria: I'll write a short RFC and attach perf graphs + flamegraphs. @alex @jin please upload raw traces to /mnt/perf/4356789012 so I can embed them.
alex: uploaded /mnt/perf/4356789012/streaming_mb_sweep.tar.gz :thumbsup:
sam: Gate for GA: stable streaming p99 < 300ms under target load. If we meet that with kernel-hint+prefetch we can set streaming default mb=2 experimental and monitor.
